blocks.zh: 本章學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 理解參數放行申請中 Content of Submissions (送件內容) 的整體架構及 FDA 審查邏輯
blocks.en: Understand the overall structure of the Content of Submissions for parametric release and the logic of FDA review

blocks.zh: 掌握 Control Strategy (控制策略) 的六大要素：CPP 選擇理由、接受標準、容器密封系統、裝載模式、微生物監控計畫
blocks.en: Master the six elements of the Control Strategy: CPP selection rationale, acceptance criteria, container closure system, loading patterns, and microbiological monitoring program

blocks.zh: 學習如何根據 ICH Q9 原則建構 Risk Assessment (風險評估) 聲明，涵蓋滅菌週期一致性、產品風險、先驗知識
blocks.en: Learn how to build a Risk Assessment statement based on ICH Q9 principles, covering sterilization cycle consistency, product risk, and prior knowledge

blocks.zh: 掌握 CDMO 在承接多客戶產品時，如何展示「先驗知識」(Prior Knowledge) 與「類似製程經驗」
blocks.en: Learn how a CDMO that takes on products from multiple clients can demonstrate "Prior Knowledge" and "experience with similar processes"

blocks.zh: III. Content of Submissions for Parametric Release 參數放行送件內容概述
blocks.en: III. Content of Submissions for Parametric Release

blocks.zh: 原文內容 Original Text
blocks.en: Original Text

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 Key Concepts
blocks.en: Key Concepts

blocks.zh: FDA 審查的核心邏輯：FDA 不是在審查「你是否完美」，而是在審查「你是否充分理解並管控了無菌性風險」。三個審查面向清楚地對應了 ICH Q9 的風險管理流程 **(ICH Q9(R1), Section 3.1)**：
blocks.en: The core logic of FDA review: FDA is not reviewing whether you are perfect. It is reviewing whether you fully understand and control the sterility risks. The three review aspects map clearly onto the ICH Q9 risk management process **(ICH Q9(R1), Section 3.1)**:

blocks.zh: Current control strategies → Risk Control (風險控制措施)
blocks.en: Current control strategies → Risk Control

blocks.zh: Risk of failure → Risk Evaluation (風險評價)
blocks.en: Risk of failure → Risk Evaluation

blocks.zh: Prior experience → Risk Identification based on knowledge (基於知識的風險識別)
blocks.en: Prior experience → Risk Identification based on knowledge

blocks.zh: Critical Process Parameters (CPPs, 關鍵製程參數)：在最終滅菌的語境中，典型的 CPPs 包括：滅菌溫度、滅菌時間、F₀ 值、腔室壓力、裝載模式。這些參數的「已驗證範圍」就是參數放行的判定依據。
blocks.en: Critical Process Parameters (CPPs): In the context of terminal sterilization, typical CPPs include sterilization temperature, sterilization time, F₀ value, chamber pressure, and loading pattern. The validated range of these parameters is the basis for the parametric release decision.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy
blocks.en: Analogy

blocks.zh: 申請參數放行就像申請「免考試畢業」。大學不會讓任何人直接免考——你必須提交一份完整的 portfolio (作品集)，證明你已經透過其他方式達到了等同甚至超越考試所能評估的學習成果。FDA 審查的就是這份「portfolio」的品質：你的控制策略是否完整、你是否理解可能的失敗模式、以及你過去的經驗是否支持這個主張。
blocks.en: Applying for parametric release is like applying to "graduate without exams". A university would never let anyone skip exams outright. You would have to submit a complete portfolio showing that you have achieved, by other means, learning outcomes equal to or better than what an exam could assess. FDA reviews the quality of that "portfolio": whether your control strategy is complete, whether you understand the possible failure modes, and whether your past experience supports the claim.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Key Notes
blocks.en: Key Notes

blocks.zh: 驗證前提不可省略：FDA 明確指出滅菌製程必須先依另一份 Guidance 完成驗證。這意味著參數放行不是「跳過驗證」的捷徑——恰恰相反，它要求比傳統放行更嚴格的驗證和製程理解 **(PDA TR30, Section 2.1)**。
blocks.en: The validation prerequisite cannot be skipped: FDA clearly states that the sterilization process must first be validated in accordance with another guidance. Parametric release is therefore not a shortcut around validation. On the contrary, it demands stricter validation and process understanding than traditional release **(PDA TR30, Section 2.1)**.

blocks.zh: ICH Q9 是框架基礎：FDA 明確要求風險評估聲明須符合 ICH Q9 原則。這不是建議，而是實質要求。CDMO 應使用 FMEA 或類似工具建立結構化的風險評估文件 **(ICH Q9(R1), Annex I)**。
blocks.en: ICH Q9 is the framework: FDA expects the risk assessment statement to follow ICH Q9 principles. This is not a suggestion but a substantive requirement. A CDMO should use FMEA or a similar tool to build a structured risk assessment document **(ICH Q9(R1), Annex I)**.

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: FDA 要求風險評估涵蓋的三個面向分別是什麼？請對應到 ICH Q9 風險管理流程的哪個步驟？
blocks.en: What are the three aspects that FDA requires the risk assessment to cover? Map each to a step in the ICH Q9 risk management process.

blocks.zh: 為什麼 FDA 強調滅菌製程必須「先完成驗證」才能申請參數放行？兩者的關係是什麼？
blocks.en: Why does FDA stress that the sterilization process must be validated before parametric release can be applied for? What is the relationship between the two?

blocks.zh: III.A Control Strategy for the Terminal Sterilization Program 最終滅菌計畫的控制策略
blocks.en: III.A Control Strategy for the Terminal Sterilization Program

blocks.zh: Control Strategy (控制策略)：不只是「列出你監控什麼參數」，而是一個完整的邏輯鏈：為什麼選這些參數 → 怎麼監控 → 什麼標準算合格 → 涵蓋哪些產品和包裝 → 裝載模式是否在驗證範圍內 → 滅菌前微生物負荷如何管控。
blocks.en: Control Strategy: This is not just "listing which parameters you monitor". It is a complete chain of logic: why these parameters were chosen → how they are monitored → what standard counts as acceptable → which products and packaging are covered → whether the loading pattern is within the validated range → how the pre-sterilization bioburden is controlled.

blocks.zh: 六大要素逐一解析：
blocks.en: The six elements, one by one:

blocks.zh: 監控方法的理由 (Rationale for methods)：不只說「我們用溫度探針」，而要說明「為什麼溫度探針的數量、位置和精度足以代表整個滅菌腔室的溫度狀態」
blocks.en: Rationale for methods: Do not just say "we use temperature probes". Explain why the number, placement, and accuracy of the probes are sufficient to represent the temperature state of the whole sterilizer chamber

blocks.zh: CPP 選擇理由 (Rationale for CPP selection)：以科學數據支持為何這些（而非其他）參數是「關鍵的」——通常來自製程開發和驗證數據
blocks.en: Rationale for CPP selection: Use scientific data to support why these parameters (and not others) are "critical"; this usually comes from process development and validation data

blocks.zh: 接受標準 (Acceptance criteria)：例如「所有探針 F₀ ≥ 15 min」、「Class 5 CI 完全變色」、「BI 無生長」
blocks.en: Acceptance criteria: For example "F₀ ≥ 15 min for all probes", "Class 5 CI fully changed", "BI shows no growth"

blocks.zh: 產品與容器密封系統：不同的容器（玻璃瓶 vs. 預填充注射器 vs. BFS 容器）和二級包裝會影響熱穿透特性
blocks.en: Product and container closure system: Different containers (glass vials vs. prefilled syringes vs. BFS containers) and secondary packaging affect heat penetration characteristics

blocks.zh: 裝載模式 (Loading patterns)：滅菌鍋的裝載方式直接影響熱分佈。任何偏離已驗證裝載模式的變更都可能需要重新驗證
blocks.en: Loading patterns: How the sterilizer is loaded directly affects heat distribution. Any change that departs from the validated loading pattern may require revalidation

blocks.zh: 微生物監控計畫：對於 bioburden-based cycle，FDA 特別強調 spore detection (芽孢偵測) 和 heat resistance studies (耐熱性研究)
blocks.en: Microbiological monitoring program: For a bioburden-based cycle, FDA places particular emphasis on spore detection and heat resistance studies

blocks.zh: 控制策略就像一份「防洪計畫」。你不只要說「我們有堤防」(monitoring method)，還要說明：為什麼堤防高度設在這個水位 (CPP selection rationale)、洪水不能超過什麼水位才算安全 (acceptance criteria)、這個堤防保護的區域範圍 (product scope)、上游水庫的蓄水模式是否在設計範圍內 (loading patterns)、以及日常的河川水質監測計畫 (microbiological monitoring)。
blocks.en: A control strategy is like a "flood control plan". It is not enough to say "we have a levee" (monitoring method). You also need to explain why the levee is set at this height (CPP selection rationale), what water level counts as safe (acceptance criteria), the area the levee protects (product scope), whether the upstream reservoir storage pattern is within design limits (loading patterns), and the routine river water quality monitoring program (microbiological monitoring).

blocks.zh: Overkill vs. Bioburden-Based 的差異影響控制策略：
blocks.en: How Overkill vs. Bioburden-Based affects the control strategy:

blocks.zh: Overkill Approach (過度殺滅法)：假設最壞情況（bioburden = 10⁶ CFU，D₁₂₁ = 1 min），通常 F₀ ≥ 12 min。微生物監控計畫可相對簡化，因為安全裕度很大 **(PDA TR30, Section 3.2)**。
blocks.en: Overkill Approach: Assumes the worst case (bioburden = 10⁶ CFU, D₁₂₁ = 1 min), typically with F₀ ≥ 12 min. The microbiological monitoring program can be relatively simple because the safety margin is large **(PDA TR30, Section 3.2)**.

blocks.zh: Bioburden-Based Approach (微生物負荷法)：根據實際 bioburden 數據設計滅菌週期，F₀ 可能低於 12 min（例如 8 min）。此時 FDA 特別強調必須進行「芽孢偵測」和「耐熱性研究」，因為安全裕度較小，微生物負荷的任何變化都直接影響 SAL **(PIC/S Annex 1 2022, Section 8.20)**。
blocks.en: Bioburden-Based Approach: The sterilization cycle is designed from actual bioburden data, and F₀ may be below 12 min (for example 8 min). In this case FDA particularly emphasizes "spore detection" and "heat resistance studies", because the safety margin is smaller and any change in bioburden directly affects SAL **(PIC/S Annex 1 2022, Section 8.20)**.

blocks.zh: CDMO 特別注意：當承接多客戶產品共用同一滅菌鍋時，裝載模式的驗證範圍必須涵蓋所有產品組合。如果新產品的瓶型或紙箱尺寸不同，可能需要補充驗證。
blocks.en: Special note for CDMOs: When products from multiple clients share the same sterilizer, the validated range of the loading pattern must cover all product combinations. If a new product has a different vial type or carton size, supplemental validation may be needed.

blocks.zh: 公式與計算 Formula
blocks.en: Formula

blocks.zh:
F₀ 值計算 (等效滅菌時間)：

F₀ = Σ Δt × 10^((T - 121.1) / z)

其中：
  Δt = 每個時間間隔（通常 1 min）
  T  = 該時間間隔的實際溫度 (°C)
  z  = z 值（通常 10°C，針對 G. stearothermophilus）
  121.1°C = 參考溫度

Overkill Approach 的典型接受標準：
  F₀(min at cold spot) ≥ 12 min (最低要求)
  F₀(min at cold spot) ≥ 15 min (常見實務目標)

Bioburden-Based Approach：
  所需 F₀ 由以下決定：
  - 實際 bioburden count
  - Most resistant isolate 的 D₁₂₁ 值
  - 目標 SAL = 10⁻⁶
blocks.en:
F₀ calculation (equivalent sterilization time):

F₀ = Σ Δt × 10^((T - 121.1) / z)

Where:
  Δt = each time interval (usually 1 min)
  T  = actual temperature during that interval (°C)
  z  = z value (usually 10°C, for G. stearothermophilus)
  121.1°C = reference temperature

Typical acceptance criteria for the Overkill Approach:
  F₀(min at cold spot) ≥ 12 min (minimum requirement)
  F₀(min at cold spot) ≥ 15 min (common practical target)

Bioburden-Based Approach:
  The required F₀ is determined by:
  - Actual bioburden count
  - D₁₂₁ value of the most resistant isolate
  - Target SAL = 10⁻⁶

blocks.zh: FDA 要求控制策略包含六個要素。如果你是 CDMO 的驗證經理，請為一個 Overkill Cycle 的 100 mL 注射用水產品草擬每個要素的內容摘要。
blocks.en: FDA requires the control strategy to include six elements. As a CDMO validation manager, draft a summary of the content of each element for an Overkill Cycle for a 100 mL water for injection product.

blocks.zh: 一家 CDMO 新增一款 250 mL 瓶裝產品到現有的參數放行計畫中。原有計畫僅涵蓋 50 mL 和 100 mL 瓶。哪些控制策略要素需要更新或重新驗證？為什麼？
blocks.en: A CDMO adds a 250 mL bottled product to its existing parametric release program. The existing program covers only 50 mL and 100 mL vials. Which control strategy elements need to be updated or revalidated, and why?

blocks.zh: 為什麼 FDA 特別在 bioburden-based cycle 中強調 spore detection 和 heat resistance studies？如果 CDMO 使用 overkill approach，是否仍需要做這些研究？
blocks.en: Why does FDA specifically emphasize spore detection and heat resistance studies for bioburden-based cycles? If a CDMO uses the overkill approach, are these studies still needed?

blocks.zh: 實務應用 Practical Application
blocks.en: Practical Application

blocks.zh: CDMO 控制策略文件範例架構：
blocks.en: Example structure of a CDMO control strategy document:

blocks.zh: III.B Risk Assessment, Process Understanding, and Prior Knowledge 風險評估、製程理解與先驗知識
blocks.en: III.B Risk Assessment, Process Understanding, and Prior Knowledge

blocks.zh: 風險評估的焦點：FDA 明確指出風險評估應聚焦於「無法達到最低 non-sterile unit probability 要求的風險」——即 SAL 未達 10⁻⁶ 的風險。這不是泛泛的品質風險評估，而是高度針對「無菌保證失敗」的專項評估。
blocks.en: Focus of the risk assessment: FDA clearly states that the risk assessment should focus on "the risk of not meeting the minimum non-sterile unit probability requirement", that is, the risk of failing to achieve SAL 10⁻⁶. This is not a general quality risk assessment but a dedicated assessment aimed squarely at "failure of sterility assurance".

blocks.zh: 四項風險來源：
blocks.en: Four sources of risk:

blocks.zh: 滅菌週期 (Sterilization Cycle)：設備故障、參數偏移、控制系統失效
blocks.en: Sterilization Cycle: Equipment failure, parameter drift, control system failure

blocks.zh: 裝載模式 (Loading Patterns)：超出驗證範圍的裝載、空氣殘留造成冷點
blocks.en: Loading Patterns: Loads outside the validated range, residual air creating cold spots

blocks.zh: 容器密封系統 (Container Closure)：密封完整性不足導致滅菌後再污染
blocks.en: Container Closure: Insufficient seal integrity leading to post-sterilization recontamination

blocks.zh: 環境污染風險 (Environmental Contamination)：滅菌前的 bioburden 水準超出假設
blocks.en: Environmental Contamination: Pre-sterilization bioburden levels exceeding the assumed level

blocks.zh: Prior Knowledge (先驗知識)：這是 FDA 給新產品的「入門通道」。即使沒有大量商業化生產數據，開發批次和註冊批次的數據也可以用來支持參數放行申請。
blocks.en: Prior Knowledge: This is FDA's "entry path" for new products. Even without a large body of commercial production data, data from development batches and registration batches can be used to support a parametric release application.

blocks.zh: 風險評估就像買保險前的健康檢查。保險公司（FDA）不會因為你說「我很健康」就直接核保，它要看：(1) 你的體檢數據一致性（週期一致性）；(2) 你面臨的具體健康風險（四項風險來源）；(3) 你的家族病史和過去的健康紀錄（先驗知識和生產經驗）。「先驗知識」就像新員工入職體檢——即使沒有長期追蹤數據，近期的全面檢查也能提供足夠的判斷基礎。
blocks.en: A risk assessment is like a health check before buying insurance. The insurer (FDA) will not underwrite you just because you say "I am healthy". It looks at: (1) the consistency of your checkup data (cycle consistency); (2) the specific health risks you face (the four sources of risk); (3) your family history and past health records (prior knowledge and manufacturing experience). "Prior knowledge" is like the pre-employment checkup for a new hire: even without long-term follow-up data, a recent comprehensive examination can provide a sufficient basis for judgment.

blocks.zh: 變更管理的風險影響：FDA 特別提到，對於已核准的申請，任何對滅菌週期、裝載模式、容器密封系統或環境的「變更」都需要提供風險評估。這直接連結到 ICH Q10 的變更管理要求 **(ICH Q10, Section 3.2.4)**。
blocks.en: Change management and risk impact: FDA specifically notes that for an approved application, any "change" to the sterilization cycle, loading pattern, container closure system, or environment requires a risk assessment. This links directly to the change management requirements of ICH Q10 **(ICH Q10, Section 3.2.4)**.

blocks.zh: 滅菌時間的單向彈性：FDA 給了一個具體範例——「最低滅菌時間不能降低，但最高滅菌時間可以增加（如果有穩定性數據支持）」。這反映了無菌保證的「決策階層」：任何降低無菌保證的變更都需要 Prior Approval Supplement，而增加安全裕度的變更則可能以較簡單的途徑處理。
blocks.en: One-way flexibility on sterilization time: FDA gives a specific example: "the minimum sterilization time cannot be reduced, but the maximum sterilization time can be increased (if supported by stability data)". This reflects the "decision hierarchy" of sterility assurance: any change that reduces sterility assurance requires a Prior Approval Supplement, whereas a change that increases the safety margin may be handled through a simpler pathway.

blocks.zh: CDMO 展示先驗知識的策略：CDMO 的優勢在於擁有大量「類似產品、類似製程」的經驗。即使特定客戶的產品是新的，CDMO 可以引用同一滅菌鍋、類似容器系統、類似裝載模式的歷史數據來建構先驗知識基礎 **(PDA TR30, Section 5.2)**。
blocks.en: How a CDMO can demonstrate prior knowledge: A CDMO's advantage is its extensive experience with "similar products and similar processes". Even if a particular client's product is new, the CDMO can cite historical data from the same sterilizer, similar container systems, and similar loading patterns to build the prior knowledge base **(PDA TR30, Section 5.2)**.

blocks.zh: FDA 提到四項無菌性風險來源。請以一個 CDMO 實際案例說明：某批產品的紙箱包裝從單層改為雙層時，這個變更如何影響參數放行的風險評估？哪些驗證需要更新？
blocks.en: FDA mentions four sources of sterility risk. Using a real CDMO case, explain how changing the carton packaging of a batch from single-layer to double-layer would affect the parametric release risk assessment. Which validations would need to be updated?

blocks.zh: 新進 CDMO 客戶的產品從未進行過參數放行。你如何利用「先驗知識」來支持這個新產品的參數放行申請？請列出至少三類可用的數據來源。
blocks.en: A new CDMO client's product has never undergone parametric release. How would you use "prior knowledge" to support parametric release for this new product? List at least three categories of usable data sources.

blocks.zh: FDA 說「最低滅菌時間不能降低」——為什麼這是一條硬性底線？如果有數據顯示更短的時間仍可達到 SAL 10⁻⁶，是否可以降低？需要走什麼法規途徑？
blocks.en: FDA says "the minimum sterilization time cannot be reduced". Why is this a hard floor? If data show that a shorter time can still achieve SAL 10⁻⁶, can it be reduced? What regulatory pathway would be required?

blocks.zh: 運用 ICH Q9 的風險管理流程（識別→分析→評價→控制→回顧），為一個 bioburden-based 滅菌週期繪製風險管理流程圖。在哪個步驟最需要投入資源？
blocks.en: Using the ICH Q9 risk management process (identify → analyze → evaluate → control → review), draw a risk management flowchart for a bioburden-based sterilization cycle. At which step is the greatest investment of resources needed?

blocks.en: CDMO risk assessment FMEA example (simplified):

blocks.zh: 此 FMEA 結構直接對應 ICH Q9 原則，可作為 FDA 送件文件的一部分 **(ICH Q9(R1), Annex I.4 FMEA)**。
blocks.en: This FMEA structure maps directly onto ICH Q9 principles and can be included as part of an FDA submission **(ICH Q9(R1), Annex I.4 FMEA)**.

blocks.zh: 本節重點回顧 Section Summary
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: FDA 審查核心：參數放行的核准取決於申請者「如何充分處理無菌性風險」，而非僅僅列出監控參數
blocks.en: The core of FDA review: Approval of parametric release depends on "how fully the applicant addresses sterility risk", not merely on listing the monitored parameters

blocks.zh: 控制策略六要素：CPP 監控方法理由、CPP 選擇理由、接受標準、產品與容器描述、裝載模式驗證、微生物監控計畫（bioburden-based 須強調芽孢偵測和耐熱性研究）
blocks.en: Six elements of the control strategy: Rationale for CPP monitoring methods, CPP selection rationale, acceptance criteria, product and container description, loading pattern validation, and microbiological monitoring program (for bioburden-based cycles, emphasize spore detection and heat resistance studies)

blocks.zh: 風險評估聚焦 SAL：評估「未達 SAL 10⁻⁶」的風險，須涵蓋滅菌週期、裝載模式、容器密封、環境污染四大來源
blocks.en: The risk assessment focuses on SAL: Assess the risk of "failing to achieve SAL 10⁻⁶", covering four sources: sterilization cycle, loading pattern, container closure, and environmental contamination

blocks.zh: 先驗知識是入門通道：新產品可用開發批次和註冊批次數據；CDMO 可引用同設備、類似產品的歷史經驗來建構先驗知識
blocks.en: Prior knowledge is the entry path: A new product can use development batch and registration batch data; a CDMO can cite historical experience with the same equipment and similar products to build prior knowledge

blocks.zh: 變更管理直接影響參數放行：任何影響無菌保證的變更都需要重新評估風險並更新控制策略，遵循 ICH Q10 變更管理原則
blocks.en: Change management directly affects parametric release: Any change that affects sterility assurance requires the risk to be reassessed and the control strategy updated, following ICH Q10 change management principles
